name: Admin Page
description: Adds a custom admin menu page extending AbstractAdminPage from rtcamp/wp-framework. Top-level by default; pass --parent_slug for a submenu.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the admin page class. Default 'Inc\Admin' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the admin page file. Default 'includes/Admin'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Admin'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Admin'.
Page slug, lowercase, kebab- or snake-case, e.g. 'my-plugin-dashboard'.
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.
Browser tab title, e.g. 'My Plugin Dashboard'.
Sidebar label, often shorter than page_title.
Parent menu slug for a submenu (e.g. 'options-general.php'). Leave empty for a top-level menu.

wiring.description: Add the page to the Admin module so the framework Loader registers it on admin_menu. If the Admin module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Admin --kind=admin-page`.
